Looping you in for a quick intake on Velar (new logo, pilot -> production if all goes well). They sent initial MSA + Order Form (attached). Key asks from sales/procurement:
- 2 week turnaround on redlines if possible; customer indicated timing sensitivity for Q3 pilot start.
- Primary negotiation items they expect to discuss: liability cap, data residency (EU fallback), SSO/SAML integration language, and an SLA uplift for dedicated capacity.

Attachments: Velar_MSA_Draft_20260729.docx, OrderForm-Velar-20260729.xlsx, velar-security-questionnaire.pdf

- Kimberly: MSA redline (primary owner) — please flag any non-starters (IP, termination, indemnity).
- David: Order Form commercial items + pricing exhibit; confirm billing contact and seat counts.
- Me (Marissa): procurement coordinator, will manage MAP and schedule kickoff call with Velar.

Can you confirm owners and a target first-pass back to customer by Aug 13 (two weeks)? If you want a pre-review sync, I can schedule 30m today or tomorrow.

Thanks Marissa — I can take primary ownership of the MSA redline.

Initial questions after a quick pass:
1) Exhibit A (Services) — the Order Form references a dedicated pool option; does Velar intend to commit to a reserved capacity SKU or start on hosted? David, can you confirm expected SKU and seat count for pricing alignment?
2) Data residency: the MSA has our standard multi-region clause. Elena, is an EU-only residency a hard requirement or preference for pilot? If hard requirement we should flag potential pricing/hosting implications.
3) Liability cap: MSA currently uses 12 months revenue cap; Velar likely will ask for higher — note we generally push for 12 months for mid-market.
4) Security evidence: thanks for the questionnaire. I'll route to Security if we need to produce any additional docs; David, flag if this needs to be included in handoff docs.

I will prepare a tracked-redline MSA and a short summary of the top 6 negotiation points by EOD tomorrow (Jul 31). If anyone prefers a short 15m pre-redline huddle to align on positions, suggest 9:30am PT tomorrow.

-Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick handoff. A few clarifications from Velar's side:
- Data residency: EU residency is a requirement for the pilot (we have EU-based customers and data must be stored within EU for processing). If that requires a different hosting SKU, please include cost delta in the MAP.
- Liability cap: we typically push for 24 months or $5M floor for these types of integrations; happy to start with a discussion.
- SSO/SAML: we have a standard SAML appendix — attaching our template.
- Timeline: 2 weeks for a first-pass redline is fine; final execution may take longer. Procurement is prepared to review as soon as tracked changes are returned.

Attachments: velar-sso-appendix.pdf (attached inline)
